scope: This is a bounded-response noise helper for P81/P84, not an independent coverage theorem. Actual response range and conditional-mean identities, parameter bounds and the other regression-confidence hypotheses remain required downstream.

The generic interval theorem assumes a<b; it does not claim a separate zero-width interval endpoint. Both required experiment ranges have strictly positive width, so this boundary does not limit the claimed sigma1/sigma3/4 applications.

All coefficientwise conditional exponential bounds have the coefficient fixed before the almost-everywhere conclusion. The separate random-multiplier theorem supplies predictable random coefficients where needed; this helper does not silently substitute them into uncountably many fixed-coefficient null events.
No empirical coverage or data authenticity follows merely from constructing these mathematical noise certificates.
